title: Commit description as a thinking tool
title_zh: Commit描述作为一种思考工具

paragraphs.en: Before the AI era, I wrote pretty long commit descriptions (or commit bodies) for major changes. It took me about five to ten minutes to draft and reread them to make sure I didn’t miss anything important. I did that for several reasons.
paragraphs.zh: 在 AI 时代之前，我会为重大改动撰写相当长的提交描述（或提交正文）。 我大约需要五到十分钟来起草并重读这些内容，以确保没有遗漏任何重要的东西。 我这样做有几个原因。

sents.en: Before the AI era, I wrote pretty long commit descriptions (or commit bodies) for major changes.
sents.zh: 在 AI 时代之前，我会为重大改动撰写相当长的提交描述（或提交正文）。

sents.en: It took me about five to ten minutes to draft and reread them to make sure I didn’t miss anything important.
sents.zh: 我大约需要五到十分钟来起草并重读这些内容，以确保没有遗漏任何重要的东西。

sents.en: I did that for several reasons.
sents.zh: 我这样做有几个原因。

paragraphs.en: I wanted to include all the useful information so readers wouldn’t have to hunt for it in multiple places.
paragraphs.zh: 我想把所有有用的信息都包含进来，这样读者就不必在多个地方查找了。

paragraphs.en: I wanted to explain what and, more importantly, why. The “what” summarizes the changes that are generally self-explanatory, but it gives a starting point for explaining the “why.”
paragraphs.zh: 我想解释一下是什么，以及更重要的，为什么。 “是什么”总结了通常一看就懂的更改，但它为解释“为什么”提供了一个起点。

sents.en: I wanted to explain what and, more importantly, why.
sents.zh: 我想解释一下是什么，以及更重要的，为什么。

sents.en: The “what” summarizes the changes that are generally self-explanatory, but it gives a starting point for explaining the “why.”
sents.zh: “是什么”总结了通常一看就懂的更改，但它为解释“为什么”提供了一个起点。

paragraphs.en: Sometimes, I write it in first person, like I am drafting a message for someone: “I did this because…”, “I am doing this until we…” etc. I then go ahead and explain why, so that it is easier for others, and most importantly for my future self, to understand why we made that change.
paragraphs.zh: 有时，我会用第一人称来写，就像在为某人起草一条消息：“我这么做是因为……”、“我会一直这么做，直到我们……”等等。 然后我会接着解释原因，这样其他人、尤其是最重要的——未来的我自己，更容易理解我们当初为什么做出那个更改。

sents.en: Sometimes, I write it in first person, like I am drafting a message for someone: “I did this because…”, “I am doing this until we…” etc.
sents.zh: 有时，我会用第一人称来写，就像在为某人起草一条消息：“我这么做是因为……”、“我会一直这么做，直到我们……”等等。

sents.en: I then go ahead and explain why, so that it is easier for others, and most importantly for my future self, to understand why we made that change.
sents.zh: 然后我会接着解释原因，这样其他人、尤其是最重要的——未来的我自己，更容易理解我们当初为什么做出那个更改。

paragraphs.en: It was a good exercise. It wasn’t just about writing the commit message and description. The writing process itself helps me reflect on the code I wrote. I reread the code and summarize the changes. During that process, I tend to re-evaluate the decisions, and sometimes that leads to a different or better change.
paragraphs.zh: 这是一个很好的练习。 这不仅仅是关于撰写提交信息和描述。 写作过程本身帮助我反思自己所写的代码。 我会重读代码并总结所做的更改。 在这个过程中，我往往会重新评估自己的决策，有时这会带来一个不同或更好的更改。

sents.en: It was a good exercise.
sents.zh: 这是一个很好的练习。

sents.en: It wasn’t just about writing the commit message and description.
sents.zh: 这不仅仅是关于撰写提交信息和描述。

sents.en: The writing process itself helps me reflect on the code I wrote.
sents.zh: 写作过程本身帮助我反思自己所写的代码。

sents.en: I reread the code and summarize the changes.
sents.zh: 我会重读代码并总结所做的更改。

sents.en: During that process, I tend to re-evaluate the decisions, and sometimes that leads to a different or better change.
sents.zh: 在这个过程中，我往往会重新评估自己的决策，有时这会带来一个不同或更好的更改。

paragraphs.en: Now we are in the era of agentic coding, where everything from code to commit descriptions is written by AI. There is a huge debate on whether we should read the AI-written code, and how difficult that is in terms of readability. The part I find difficult is reading and understanding AI-written commit descriptions.
paragraphs.zh: 现在我们进入了智能体编程的时代，从代码到提交说明，一切都由 AI 来编写。 关于我们是否应该阅读 AI 编写的代码，以及从可读性角度来说这有多难，目前存在很大的争论。 我觉得困难的部分是阅读和理解 AI 编写的提交说明。

sents.en: Now we are in the era of agentic coding, where everything from code to commit descriptions is written by AI.
sents.zh: 现在我们进入了智能体编程的时代，从代码到提交说明，一切都由 AI 来编写。

sents.en: There is a huge debate on whether we should read the AI-written code, and how difficult that is in terms of readability.
sents.zh: 关于我们是否应该阅读 AI 编写的代码，以及从可读性角度来说这有多难，目前存在很大的争论。

sents.en: The part I find difficult is reading and understanding AI-written commit descriptions.
sents.zh: 我觉得困难的部分是阅读和理解 AI 编写的提交说明。

paragraphs.en: Agents can write commit messages for the changes they make. But they may not have the full context that is spread across different communication and project management tools. Some of those might be offline too. When the AI doesn’t know the ‘why’ part, it comes up with its own reasoning. I find that dangerous. When we read that later, it may not make sense, because the real reason was completely different.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体可以为自己所做的更改编写提交信息。 但它们可能无法获得散布在不同沟通工具和项目管理工具中的完整上下文。 其中一些工具可能还是离线的。 当 AI 不知道「为什么」这一部分时，它会自行编造理由。我觉得这很危险。 当我们之后读到这些内容时，可能会觉得毫无意义，因为真正的原因完全不同。

sents.en: Agents can write commit messages for the changes they make.
sents.zh: 智能体可以为自己所做的更改编写提交信息。

sents.en: But they may not have the full context that is spread across different communication and project management tools.
sents.zh: 但它们可能无法获得散布在不同沟通工具和项目管理工具中的完整上下文。

sents.en: Some of those might be offline too.
sents.zh: 其中一些工具可能还是离线的。

sents.en: When the AI doesn’t know the ‘why’ part, it comes up with its own reasoning. I find that dangerous.
sents.zh: 当 AI 不知道「为什么」这一部分时，它会自行编造理由。我觉得这很危险。

sents.en: When we read that later, it may not make sense, because the real reason was completely different.
sents.zh: 当我们之后读到这些内容时，可能会觉得毫无意义，因为真正的原因完全不同。

paragraphs.en: One obvious solution is to give the agent all the context it needs, through chat or tools. This helps to fix the issues with fabricated reasoning. The agent can now explain the “why” clearly.
paragraphs.zh: 一个显而易见的解决方案是通过聊天或工具为智能体提供它所需的全部上下文。 这有助于解决编造推理的问题。 智能体现在可以清晰地解释“为什么”。

sents.en: One obvious solution is to give the agent all the context it needs, through chat or tools.
sents.zh: 一个显而易见的解决方案是通过聊天或工具为智能体提供它所需的全部上下文。

sents.en: This helps to fix the issues with fabricated reasoning.
sents.zh: 这有助于解决编造推理的问题。

sents.en: The agent can now explain the “why” clearly.
sents.zh: 智能体现在可以清晰地解释“为什么”。

paragraphs.en: But this doesn’t fix the other problem. The agent with the right context will write a convincing commit message. But only I can verify if the code does what the description says. So, here is something I do:
paragraphs.zh: 但这并不能解决另一个问题。 拥有正确上下文的智能体会写出一条有说服力的提交信息。 但只有我才能验证代码是否做到了描述所说的内容。 所以，我会这样做：

sents.en: But this doesn’t fix the other problem.
sents.zh: 但这并不能解决另一个问题。

sents.en: The agent with the right context will write a convincing commit message.
sents.zh: 拥有正确上下文的智能体会写出一条有说服力的提交信息。

sents.en: But only I can verify if the code does what the description says.
sents.zh: 但只有我才能验证代码是否做到了描述所说的内容。

sents.en: So, here is something I do:
sents.zh: 所以，我会这样做：

paragraphs.en: Write the commit message and description myself.
paragraphs.zh: 我自己来撰写提交信息（commit message）和描述。

paragraphs.en: Writing a commit description myself helps me to reflect on the changes AI made. It is also a way to check if everything is as intended. If I cannot explain “why,” I am shipping something I don’t understand, which will be hard to explain or fix if it breaks later. It goes back to the old quote. If you cannot explain it, you did not understand it. The commit description again works here as a thinking tool.
paragraphs.zh: 亲自撰写提交说明有助于我反思 AI 所做的更改。 这也是一种检查一切是否符合预期的方式。 如果我无法解释「为什么」，那我就交付了一个自己不理解的东西，日后它出问题时将难以解释或修复。 这又回到了那句老话。 如果你无法解释它，说明你并没有理解它。 提交说明在这里再次发挥了思考工具的作用。

sents.en: Writing a commit description myself helps me to reflect on the changes AI made.
sents.zh: 亲自撰写提交说明有助于我反思 AI 所做的更改。

sents.en: It is also a way to check if everything is as intended.
sents.zh: 这也是一种检查一切是否符合预期的方式。

sents.en: If I cannot explain “why,” I am shipping something I don’t understand, which will be hard to explain or fix if it breaks later.
sents.zh: 如果我无法解释「为什么」，那我就交付了一个自己不理解的东西，日后它出问题时将难以解释或修复。

sents.en: It goes back to the old quote.
sents.zh: 这又回到了那句老话。

sents.en: If you cannot explain it, you did not understand it.
sents.zh: 如果你无法解释它，说明你并没有理解它。

sents.en: The commit description again works here as a thinking tool.
sents.zh: 提交说明在这里再次发挥了思考工具的作用。

paragraphs.en: Some parts, like “I am doing this until we…”, are temporary decisions with exit criteria. We sometimes set exit conditions, and AI cannot infer them from code or other tools because they are usually not written down anywhere since they seem too obvious to mention. But writing the commit message forces me to complete that sentence, and it helps future readers decide whether to keep that change.
paragraphs.zh: 有些部分，比如“我要这样做，直到我们……”，是带有退出标准的临时决定。 我们有时会设定退出条件，而 AI 无法从代码或其他工具中推断出这些条件，因为它们通常没有写在任何地方，因为它们看起来太明显了，不值得提及。 但是写提交信息会迫使我把那句话补充完整，这有助于未来的读者判断是否保留该更改。

sents.en: Some parts, like “I am doing this until we…”, are temporary decisions with exit criteria.
sents.zh: 有些部分，比如“我要这样做，直到我们……”，是带有退出标准的临时决定。

sents.en: We sometimes set exit conditions, and AI cannot infer them from code or other tools because they are usually not written down anywhere since they seem too obvious to mention.
sents.zh: 我们有时会设定退出条件，而 AI 无法从代码或其他工具中推断出这些条件，因为它们通常没有写在任何地方，因为它们看起来太明显了，不值得提及。

sents.en: But writing the commit message forces me to complete that sentence, and it helps future readers decide whether to keep that change.
sents.zh: 但是写提交信息会迫使我把那句话补充完整，这有助于未来的读者判断是否保留该更改。

paragraphs.en: The agent can write the code and the description. But writing why is where you find out whether you understand what you are shipping.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体可以编写代码和描述。 但写下“为什么”才能让你弄清自己是否真正理解你所交付的东西。

sents.en: The agent can write the code and the description.
sents.zh: 智能体可以编写代码和描述。

sents.en: But writing why is where you find out whether you understand what you are shipping.
sents.zh: 但写下“为什么”才能让你弄清自己是否真正理解你所交付的东西。
